It felt like everything that could possibly go wrong, did go wrong, and Shigure was sure that dealing with all the mishaps in the office took off about 10 years of his life. All he wanted to do was relax at home and relieve some of the stress he accumulated throughout the day.*

*With a permanent frown etched on his face, Shigure walked inside his home. It was quiet and warm, just how he liked it, but the warmth of his home wasn't enough to relieve the overwhelming stress and tension that had built up in him. He took off his coat and tossed it on the chair before plopping down on the couch and turning on the TV.*

*He scrolled through the channels mindlessly, hoping to take his mind off of work, but to no avail. Nothing was working. He felt just as tense as he did when he was in the office.
